structured_output.what_is_happening: A cluster of Solana tokens called "Last pack magic" / $JIRACHI launched about 1–2 hours ago. They ride a real, sad news story. Avery the Poke Kid was a 12-year-old Pokémon pack-opening creator who died of cancer. On Sept 22 his family posted his final pack opening, where he called for "last pack magic" and pulled a Jirachi SIR. Dexerto covered it, and the card's artist responded. This token (DYHsj…) is a PumpSwap pair created at 11:19 UTC. The launchpad field says meteora_virtual_curve and it was created and migrated in the same second. The token rose about 300% over 6h, then fell about 63% in the last 5 minutes. It is one of at least 10 same-name clones. The biggest by market cap and liquidity is HMD6LV9… (about $465k–$515k, several pools, linked to X account @kadedoteth). HUjiM…, created within 3 seconds of this one, is also dumping.

narrative.description: Viral, emotional Pokémon TCG story: the late child creator Avery's final pull, a Jirachi SIR with "last pack magic". Covered by Dexerto, HypeFresh, Player.One and Elite Fourum, and the card artist Akira Egawa responded. The event is real and current (Sept 22–24). No crypto-side discussion of this specific contract was found.
narrative.why_spreading: A touching real story in a huge fandom went viral on X/TikTok at the same time the Jirachi 30th SIR card was already hyped. Memecoin launchers then spun up many clones within about an hour. The tragedy framing may also cap how much mainstream attention a coin can capture.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is one of 10+ identical-name clones. It has no socials of its own; its X link points to Dexerto's tweet. It was not first: HMD6 was created about 18 minutes earlier and 8viD about 17 minutes earlier. It is not the market leader either; HMD6 has about twice the market cap, multiple pools and a linked X account. The creator has launched 38 tokens, the dev's X account is linked to 247, and GMGN shows the creator has closed out ('creator_close').
token_connection.competing_tokens: HMD6LV9… (the leader, about $465k market cap, $64k liquidity, $870k h1 volume, @kadedoteth). HUjiM… (launched the same second as this one, $1.25M h1 volume, now -25%). DgteWj… ($276k). 8viD… and GamY… have a suspicious ~$1.4M liquidity on FluxBeam but almost no volume. Several small pump.fun clones as well.

authenticity.evidence: In the last hour, 1,404 unique buyers but only 89 unique sellers, with 5,089 buys. That pattern points to bot or bundled micro-buys, not organic trading. GMGN flags 63 bundler wallets and 78 'top' wallets, with a 7% entrapment trader share. A serial deployer (38 launches) and a near-simultaneous twin launch (HUjiM, 3 seconds apart) fit a clone-farm strategy. There is no project community, website or Telegram. The single largest holder has 80% and is unlabeled, possibly a pool or locker account. Price is -63% in 5 minutes.
authenticity.uncertainty: The 80% top holder may be a pool or vault that RugCheck mislabels; GMGN reports top10 at 8.6% and lp_burn 1.0. X data could not be accessed directly, so there may be CA shills I didn't see.

structural_risks: 10+ clones split the flow, and the leader is a different contract
Already dumped 63% in 5 minutes, which looks like distribution after a 4x
Serial deployer (38 tokens) who has already exited
The buyer/seller asymmetry suggests volume bots and bundlers
RugCheck flags LP as unlocked (0% locked on one market), though GMGN says burned

structured_output.counterargument: The story is real, emotional and still spreading through Pokémon media. Liquidity of $33k against a $218k market cap means a fresh wave of buyers could easily double it from the post-dump low. Clone wars sometimes rotate back to a non-leading clone that holds high volume. The 63% drop may have been a single whale exit that has now cleared, and 1,400+ unique buyers show broad retail participation.
unknowns: Whether the 80% top holder is a pool/vault account or a real wallet
Actual X/Telegram shilling of this specific CA
Whether the HMD6 leader will absorb all remaining flow
The price at entry after the -63% candle

source_coverage.notes: X results covered only the narrative source (Dexerto tweet, Jirachi lore posts). No posts mentioning this contract were found, and a CA search returned only noise. News coverage of the Avery story is real. DexScreener search confirmed the clone field. The packet's stonkfun.xyz website is a launchpad, not a project site, so I didn't fetch it.

structured_output.thesis: The narrative is real but already farmed. This token is a non-canonical clone from a serial deployer, with bot-like buy patterns, and it is mid-dump (-63% in 5 minutes). Doubling from entry within 6h would need renewed rotation into this specific clone rather than the leader HMD6. That is unlikely.
